Instead, I’d put on a 24h Print Long about 3% below the mark at 5×. If it keeps running, I take the yield and stay out. If it cools into my level by the checkpoint, I get the entry I wanted.

If you trade options, this is similar to selling a one-day put a few percent out of the money. The yield is the premium, my target is the strike and the checkpoint acts like expiry. items.author: 0xQuit
items.new_information: 攻击路径为恶意7702委托加sweep；成因有授权签名被钓鱼与签名/私钥泄露两种说法

evidence.quote: 1. The attacker deployed a delegate contract, 0x63e842b0...73e9c6fAe, from the relayer at 15:59 UTC.
2. About four hours later, the relayer submitted an EIP-7702 authorization transaction
That installed the malicious 7702 delegate code on Binance 14.
3. The relayer then made a call to Binance 14, executing the delegate code, and transferring Binance 14’s ETH and token balances.
• The relayer 0x7C... was funded by three Tornado Cash 0.1 ETH withdrawals over the prior two days.

What's a bit unclear is why the relayer was needed in the first place. If they had the private keys to the Binance wallets, they could have just sent the assets out in an atomic bundle without needing a relayer at all.
So it seems likely that they didn't have the private keys and instead just had the 7702 auth signatures, which must have been phished somehow.
Type: Delegation Abuse (EIP-7702) / Private Key Compromise

The Binance hot wallet 0x28c6…1d60 was made to carry an EIP-7702 delegation (code 0xef0100 + 63e842b0…) pointing at a wallet-drainer implementation — the same kit flagged pre-drain for operator 0x7c8601d4 (Tornado-funded). In this tx the operator EOA (NOT the account owner) called sweep(address recipient, address[] tokens) = selector 0x8a179be4, and the

delegate code transferred the wallet's entire token inventory — ~1.62B USDT, 167K ETH, UNI, LINK, PEPE, ENA, wBETH, xaut, PAXG, WBTC and ~60 other assets — to attacker collection address 0x5227f603c1ee34ce3c06efe6477003bdfccb2f8c. Net ~$2.53B drained. Setting a 7702 delegation requires a signature from the account's own key, so this is a signing/private-key
compromise of an exchange hot wallet, extracted via an operator-gated universal sweep.
Data made by @DefimonAlerts
A Binance-labeled wallet moved 167,464 ETH + 63 tokens, including 1.615B USDT, just 3m24s after a signed delegation was installed.

花不花你的钱：自查多用的是 Anthropic 自己服务器的算力，按它的估算，整体推理算力增加不到 2%。Anthropic 说这笔成本不向客户收费。
会不会被误封：被标记不等于违规。Anthropic 说评估只是“需要进一步审查的信号”，单条标记不作数。在一部分危害领域，标记每晚按组织汇总，同一个组织攒了好几条高优先级标记，才交给执法团队人工复查。自我评估本身只在事后标记，不会当场打断你的对话，当场拦截由其他安全分类器负责。
衡量标准就是那位贵的审查员。在 Fable 5 的真实流量抽样里，把误报控制在 1%（每 100 段正常对话误标 1 段）时，审查员标出的可疑对话，自我评估能抓到 78%；其中高优先级（7 分及以上）的能抓到 94%。
把这些标记聚类后，发现了几类原有防线没专门覆盖的问题：违规蒸馏（套取 Claude 的推理过程，拿去训练别的模型）、提示词注入（藏在网页或文件里劫持 AI 的指令），以及 Claude 作为智能体执行了用户没授权的操作。
